status: PREPARED, NOT RUN. Nothing in this suite has been generated, rendered or scored yet. Run it only after the user approves.
purpose: Does the same engine adapt its visual decisions to topics it was never tuned on? Target visual language = the 17 reference videos. Bomb and railroads are the tuning cases and are NOT in this suite.

L1_story_intelligence.what: script understanding, beat generation, shot selection, narrative sync
automatic: recipe sequence is not a copy of another topic's sequence
selector records a reason per beat
ai_assisted: Gemini/Claude reads plan + narration and flags beats whose picture does not do what the words do
human: does the plan tell this story, and is each choice justified?
L1_story_intelligence.pass_rule: all automatic checks pass AND no human-flagged story mismatch

L2_visual_quality.what: character consistency, object visibility, composition, materials, lighting, environments
automatic: pixel checks on stills (not black/flat, colour strength vs references)
ai_assisted: same character looks the same across stills
material reads as the right material
human: attractive, professional look vs the references
L2_visual_quality.pass_rule: never claimed from the plan or from a drawn storyboard

L3_animation_quality.what: acting, gestures, object physics, collisions, camera motion, transitions, timing
ai_assisted: does the collision look like a collision
human: motion, acting and timing feel right
L3_animation_quality.pass_rule: never claimed from beat validation or still contact sheets

universal_vs_specialised.specialised_profiles: topic behaviours enter ONLY as profile files passed to shot_selector.py --profile (recipe bias, extra candidates, required capabilities). A profile may not change a universal rule. None is shipped; every behaviour below marked 'not implemented' is a gap, not a capability.

material_implementations.note: readability is universal; implementation is per material
material_implementations.fire_smoke: billboard_fx exists in kit, not verified per topic
